final_answer.key_evidence_summary: Pod listing shows adservice-d6c9fcc6b-d4nlb as the only outlier with RESTARTS 2 (30s ago) while all other 10 boutique services are at 0 restarts; GetAlerts reports no metric anomalies, so the fault is object-layer. Its pod detail shows Last State Terminated with Reason Error and Exit Code 143 (SIGTERM by kubelet, not 137 OOMKilled) plus events 'Liveness probe failed: Get "http://172.20.2.163:9555/": net/http: HTTP/1.x transport connection broken: malformed HTTP status code "\x00\x00\x00\x04..."' (x9) and 'Killing: Container server failed liveness probe, will be restarted' (x3). Server-side logs mirror the same event: 'io.netty.handler.codec.http2.Http2Exception: Unexpected HTTP/1.x request: GET /' at Http2ConnectionHandler$PrefaceDecoder.readClientPrefaceString, i.e. the gRPC/HTTP2 server received an HTTP/1.1 request. GetAppYAML(adservice) closes the chain on the configuration face: the Service port is named grpc:9555 and readinessProbe correctly uses 'grpc: port 9555', but livenessProbe wrongly uses 'httpGet: {path: /, port: 9555}' against the same gRPC port. The protocol mismatch makes the liveness probe fail permanently (period=10s, failureThreshold=3), so kubelet kills and restarts the container repeatedly - the reported abnormal restart.
